explanation: YouTube was originally a video dating site called 'Tune In Hook Up' before pivoting to general video sharing

fact_urdu: ایپل کی پہلی پروڈکٹ کی قیمت 666.66 ڈالر تھی
explanation: Steve Jobs chose this price. Wozniak liked repeating digits. No satanic connection despite conspiracy theories

explanation: Voyager spacecraft launched in 1977 still operate on original computers with less power than modern calculator

explanation: Zuckerberg has red-green colorblindness and blue is the color he sees best

fact_urdu: انسٹاگرام 2 سال میں 1 بلین میں بکا
fact_english: Instagram sold for $1 billion after only 2 years
explanation: Instagram launched in October 2010 and was acquired by Facebook in April 2012 for $1 billion with only 13 employees
